Antigravity Awesome Skills is an installable GitHub library and npm installer for reusable SKILL.md playbooks.
It is designed for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Antigravity, Kiro, OpenCode, GitHub Copilot, and other AI coding assistants that benefit from structured operating instructions.
Installable, not just inspirational: use npx antigravity-awesome-skills to put skills where your tool expects them.
Built for major agent workflows: Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Antigravity, Kiro, OpenCode, Copilot, and more.
Broad coverage with real utility: 1,460+ skills across development, testing, security, infrastructure, product, and marketing.
